description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases for verifying the functionality of a 'git blame' heuristic ignoring fuzzy matches. It sets up various test scenarios, runs 'git blame' with specific options, and compares the output against expected results. It references external testing libraries and manipulates git repositories for each test case.

methods.name: pick_author
methods.description: A sed substitution pattern used to extract the author name from git blame output.
